title: Relay.posted bool is a sticky 'page has posted' flag beside the Page stage enum
trigger: Close{notify_page} read after the page posts once; never cleared on load_started (new document)
effect: After a reload the close notice is still sent to a document that has not posted; harmless today
fix: fold into Document/Page stage (e.g. a Posted marker on Page::Talking/Listening) so a new Document resets it

title: ShellNavigated resets Stage to Booting(empty), dropping commands queued while Booting and abandoning a pending Capturing deadline
trigger: Shell page re-navigates to INDEX_URL while commands are queued or while Stage::Capturing
effect: Queued Load/SetTheme commands lost; capture never fires (screenshot demo only)
fix: keep the queue across ShellNavigated, or carry the queue in the replacing Booting

title: Stage::Watching{token} names a watcher thread that is spawn_guarded (detached); a u64 token tells old wake-ups from the current one
trigger: resources/subscribe, unsubscribe, subscribe again quickly on one connection
effect: Old watcher thread lingers until its next 10 s wait or 600 s park ends; it exits once is_current is false, so no wrong notification
fix: hold the watcher's join/cancel handle in the stage (Watching { _watcher: TaskHandle }) so stop() ends it

title: revoke() refuses by agent name; the fallback name 'An agent' is shared by every client that sends no client name
trigger: Two agents connect without a client name; the user presses Disconnect on one in Settings
effect: refused_from() matches r.agent == agent, so the other anonymous agent is refused with REVOKED_MESSAGE too, until Allow again
fix: key the refusal on process id (or a connection token) and use the name only for display

title: allow_all_again() clears the refused list without poking the UI
trigger: Agent access switched off while an agent is listed as refused
effect: Refused list is empty but Settings keeps showing it until the next unrelated poke (set_enabled pokes right after, so only a window)
fix: poke inside allow_all_again, or make the roster own its change notification

title: AiComposeBox::sent overwrites an in-flight CardState::Loading without cancelling the older request
trigger: Change style or language twice quickly while the first AI request is still loading
effect: The older request's answer is dropped by the RequestId match, but the request stays live in TDLib (wasted work, counts toward the AI flood limit)
fix: have sent() return the replaced RequestId so the caller cancels it, or hold a cancel handle in Loading

title: set_thermal reads thermal_hot() then writes it in two steps
trigger: Two threads report thermal changes at once (Fair after Serious)
effect: A stale hysteresis result can be written; self-corrects on the next thermal report
fix: one compare_exchange / fetch_update on the packed slot
